Whenever a question asks for "percent greater than," "percent less than," or "percent change," you can use this formula:

$$\text{Percent Change} = \frac{\text{Difference}}{\text{Original}} \times 100$$

The "Original" (or baseline) is always the number that comes right after the word **"than"**. Since the question asks "what percent greater **than $a$**," our baseline is $a$.
